subject.title: feat: per-channel debounce/cap/drop queue options (mode already supported)

question: What public config shape should OpenClaw use for per-channel queue cap and drop overrides without breaking the existing string-valued messages.queue.byChannel mode map?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but choosing between separate maps, a nested byChannel shape, or keeping cap/drop global is a public config/API decision with compatibility impact.

options.title: Add separate cap/drop maps
options.body: Add explicit maps such as capByChannel and dropByChannel so the existing byChannel mode contract stays intact and no doctor migration is required.

options.title: Reshape byChannel with migration
options.body: Convert byChannel into a nested per-channel object and include a doctor migration for existing string-valued mode configs.

options.title: Keep cap/drop global
options.body: Document that cap/drop are intentionally global or session-only and close the remaining feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Add separate cap/drop maps
recommendation.body: Add explicit maps such as capByChannel and dropByChannel so the existing byChannel mode contract stays intact and no doctor migration is required.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the adjacent per-channel debounce config and has the strongest history on this queue config boundary.
